company_name: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Ltd

canvas_categories.order_inflow_changes: Active green financing pipeline continues expanding past ₹1,02,400 crore towards the landmark ₹1 Lakh Crore loan book milestone across utility solar, wind-solar hybrid, BESS, green hydrogen, and pumped hydro storage; supported by fresh sanction approvals exceeding ₹3,400 crore, Q2 disbursements surging 31% YoY to ₹10,579 crore, outstanding loan assets expanding past ₹98,900 crore, alongside major sanctions including ₹2,941.19 crore finalized for NOPL Solar Projects and decentralized solar mandates under PM Surya Ghar.
canvas_categories.direct_company_news: (2026-11-21) IREDA Share Price - Upstox [Upstox] | (2026-11-19) IREDA shares rally 30% so far in November, on track for best month since July 2024; expert sees further... - Moneycontrol.com [Moneycontrol.com] | (2026-11-20) IREDA Share Price Jumps 30% in November After Six-Month Losing Streak; PSU Stock Rebounds From ₹98.78 Low - Kotak Neo [Kotak Neo]
canvas_categories.promoter_activity: Promoter (Government of India via MNRE) maintains 71.76% sovereign equity holding, ensuring Navratna CPSE operational autonomy, sovereign capital backing, top-level CMD tenure certainty under Jatin Kumar Nayak (superannuation June 30, 2029), and AAA domestic credit ratings.
canvas_categories.demand_cycle_changes: Accelerated multi-gigawatt renewable auctions, state FDRE mandates, Green Energy Corridor Phase-III approvals, and PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar deployments drive sustained double-digit loan disbursement demand across utility-scale green infrastructure and decentralized clean energy projects.
canvas_categories.raw_material_changes: Global solar PV module and battery storage cell price stability maintains strong debt service coverage ratios (DSCR > 1.35x) across funded borrower project portfolios, minimizing asset quality and credit default risks.
canvas_categories.institutional_activity: Global sovereign wealth funds (GIC, ADIA) and domestic institutional funds drove elevated trading volumes, consolidating the stock past ₹131–₹133, attracted by the finalized $500M international green bond syndicate at +102 bps, imminent ₹1 Lakh Crore loan book milestone, and pristine 1.08% Net NPAs.
canvas_categories.government_policy_changes: Union Cabinet's Green Energy Corridor Phase-III scheme, operationalization of PM-eBus Sewa Payment Security Mechanism (PSM ₹3,435 Cr), MNRE performance MoU targets, and targeted financing directives under MSKVY 2.0 bolster IREDA's Navratna lending scope.
canvas_categories.sector_news: India's non-fossil installed capacity exceeds 210 GW on track to 500 GW by 2030, with national solar capacity scaling toward 175 GW, underpinning multi-decade green infrastructure debt demand and expanding loan securitization opportunities for specialized non-banking lenders.
canvas_categories.management_commentary: Management reaffirmed that executing the $500M international green bond at benchmark tight spreads validates IREDA's global credibility, while operationalizing the ₹1,000 crore retail subsidiary will accelerate high-margin rooftop solar lending under PM Surya Ghar, compounding loan assets to ₹1,50,000 crore by FY28.
canvas_categories.competitor_news: Power Finance Corporation (PFC) and REC Ltd continue expanding competitive green power lending portfolios, while IREDA maintains differentiated pure-play focus on emerging clean energy vectors including green hydrogen, small hydro, MSKVY solar, and EV infrastructure.
